3489:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
3490:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
3491:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
3492:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
3493:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
3494:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
3495:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
3496:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3497:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3498:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
3499:+    if(phase==2){
3500:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
3501:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3502:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
3503:+    }
3504:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
3505:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3506:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3507:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3508:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3509:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}

3513:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
3514:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
3515:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
3516:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
3517:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
3518:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
3519:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
3520:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
3521:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
3522:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}

4080:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}committed.*=written;return N19_OK;

4083:+fn n19_read_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
4084:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4085:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rootfd as i32);}
4086:+    let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
4087:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

4093:+    let rc:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(fd);
4094:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

4099:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;

4101:+    let rc:i32=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,attempted,committed);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
4102:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

4105:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
4106:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4107:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
4108:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
4109:+    let prior:N19State=n19_empty_state();let recovered:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,&prior);
4110:+    if(recovered!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,recovered);}
4111:+    if(prior.sequence!=1 || prior.event_count!=1 || prior.journal_bytes!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || prior.audit_head!=1 || prior.recovered!=1){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
4112:+    let end:i64=n19_seek(fd,0,2);if(end<0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
4113:+    if(end!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
4114:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
4115:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,2,"native-append");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc0);}

4117:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
4118:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}

4120:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
4121:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;

4124:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
4125:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4126:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
4127:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
4128:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
4129:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
4130:+}
4131:+
4132:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
4133:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
4134:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
4135:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4136:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
4137:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
4138:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
4139:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
4140:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
4141:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
4142:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
4143:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

4155:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}

4158:+    let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture(root,leaf,&state);if(rc==N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return rc;}if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}return N19_REFUSED_IO;

4161:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
4162:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
4163:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
4164:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
4165:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4166:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
4167:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
4168:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4169:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4170:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4171:+    if(phase==2){
4172:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
4173:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4174:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
4175:+    }
4176:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
4177:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4178:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4179:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4180:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4181:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4182:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
4183:+}
4184:+
4185:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
4186:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
4187:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
4188:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
4189:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
4190:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
4191:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
4192:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
4193:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4194:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4195:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
4196:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
4197:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
4198:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
4199:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
4200:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
4201:+}

4270:+
4271:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
4272:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
4273:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
4274:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
4275:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
4276:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
4277:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
4278:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
4279:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
4280:+    return N19_OK;
4281:+}

4286:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
4287:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
4288:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");

4291:+fn main()i32 {
4292:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
4293:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
4294:+    // registry state.
4295:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
4296:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
4297:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
4298:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-overflow")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_overflow();n19_emit("overflow",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_OVERFLOW);}
4299:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-capacity")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_capacity();n19_emit("capacity",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY);}
4300:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_recovery(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
4301:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-corruption")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_corruption();n19_emit("corruption",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
4302:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery-atomicity")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_failed_recovery_atomicity(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery_atomicity",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
4303:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-limit")==1){let rc:i32=n19_apply_limits(1,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);n19_emit_limit(rc,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
4304:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-error-classification")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_error_classification();n19_emit("error_classification",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
4305:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),1));}
4306:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-half-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),2));}
4307:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-full-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),3));}
4308:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-file-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),4));}
4309:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-root-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),5));}
4310:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-resource-fsize")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_resource_fsize(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
4311:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_open(_zag_arg(2)));}

4848:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
4849:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
4850:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
4851:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
4852:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4853:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
4854:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
4855:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4856:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4857:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
4858:+    if(phase==2){
4859:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
4860:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4861:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
4862:+    }
4863:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
4864:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4865:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4866:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}

4872:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
4873:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
4874:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
4875:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
4876:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {

4880:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4881:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
4882:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
4883:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}

5406:+    return N19_OK;

5409:+fn n19_write_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
5410:+    if(attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5411:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
5412:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
5413:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}return rc;

5416:+fn n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
5417:+    if(attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5418:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
5419:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){return fd as i32;}
5420:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5421:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,1,"native-io");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return rc0;}
5422:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
5423:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5424:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5425:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
5426:+}

5428:+fn n19_read_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
5429:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5430:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rootfd as i32);}
5431:+    let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
5432:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

5436:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5437:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
5438:+    let rc:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(fd);
5439:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

5443:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5444:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;

5450:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
5451:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5452:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
5453:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
5454:+    let prior:N19State=n19_empty_state();let recovered:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,&prior);
5455:+    if(recovered!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,recovered);}
5456:+    if(prior.sequence!=1 || prior.event_count!=1 || prior.journal_bytes!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || prior.audit_head!=1 || prior.recovered!=1){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
5457:+    let end:i64=n19_seek(fd,0,2);if(end<0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
5458:+    if(end!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
5459:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
5460:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,2,"native-append");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc0);}
5461:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);
5462:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
5463:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
5464:+    let applied:i32=n19_append(&prior,record);n19_free(record);if(applied!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,applied);}
5465:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
5466:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;

5469:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
5470:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5471:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
5472:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
5473:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
5474:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
5475:+}
5476:+
5477:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
5478:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
5479:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
5480:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5481:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
5482:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
5483:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
5484:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
5485:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
5486:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
5487:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
5488:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
5489:+}

5491:+fn n19_probe_existing(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {

5499:+fn n19_case_torn(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
5500:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}

5503:+    let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture(root,leaf,&state);if(rc==N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return rc;}if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}return N19_REFUSED_IO;

5505:+
5506:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
5507:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
5508:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
5509:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
5510:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5511:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
5512:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
5513:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5514:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5515:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5516:+    if(phase==2){
5517:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
5518:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5519:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
5520:+    }
5521:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
5522:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5523:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5524:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5525:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5526:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5527:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
5528:+}
5529:+
5530:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
5531:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
5532:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
5533:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
5534:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
5535:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
5536:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
5537:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
5538:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5539:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
5540:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
5541:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
5542:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
5543:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
5544:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
5545:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
5546:+}

5586:+fn n19_emit(name:[]u8,rc:i32)void {

5596:+fn n19_emit_state(name:[]u8,rc:i32,state:*N19State,attempted:i64,committed:i64)void {
5597:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
5598:+    _zag_print(",0,");n19_print_i64(attempted);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(committed);
5599:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.sequence as i64);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.event_count as i64);
5600:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.audit_head as i64);
5601:+    _zag_print(",-1,-1,");
5602:+    if(rc!=N19_OK || state.*.poisoned==1){_zag_print("poisoned");}
5603:+    else if(state.*.recovered==1){_zag_print("recovered");}
5604:+    else{_zag_print("fresh");}
5605:+    _zag_println(",-1,-1");
5606:+}

5613:+    if(rc==want){return 0;}return 1;

5615:+
5616:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
5617:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
5618:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
5619:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
5620:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5621:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5622:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5623:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5624:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5625:+    return N19_OK;
5626:+}

5628:+fn n19_emit_limit(rc:i32,configured:i64)void {
5629:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,limit,status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
5630:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,");n19_print_i64(configured);
5631:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
5632:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
5633:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");
5634:+}
5635:+
5636:+fn main()i32 {
5637:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
5638:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
5639:+    // registry state.
5640:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
5641:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
5642:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
5643:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-overflow")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_overflow();n19_emit("overflow",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_OVERFLOW);}
5644:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-capacity")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_capacity();n19_emit("capacity",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY);}
5645:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_recovery(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
5646:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-corruption")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_corruption();n19_emit("corruption",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
5647:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery-atomicity")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_failed_recovery_atomicity(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery_atomicity",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
5648:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-limit")==1){let rc:i32=n19_apply_limits(1,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);n19_emit_limit(rc,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}

5962:+fn n19_encode(record:[]u8,sequence:i32,payload:[]u8) i32 {
5963:+    if(record.len!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || payload.len>N19_PAYLOAD_BYTES){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5964:+    n19_put32(record,0,N19_MAGIC);n19_put32(record,4,sequence);n19_put32(record,8,payload.len);
5965:+    let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_PAYLOAD_BYTES){record[12+i]=0;i=i+1;}
5966:+    i=0;while(i<payload.len){record[12+i]=payload[i];i=i+1;}
5967:+    n19_put32(record,28,n19_checksum(record,28));return N19_OK;
5968:+}
5969:+
5970:+fn n19_validate(record:[]u8,expected_sequence:i32)i32 {
5971:+    if(record.len!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5972:+    if(n19_get32(record,0)!=N19_MAGIC || n19_get32(record,4)!=expected_sequence){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5973:+    let n:i32=n19_get32(record,8);
5974:+    if(n<0 || n>N19_PAYLOAD_BYTES){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5975:+    if(n19_get32(record,28)!=n19_checksum(record,28)){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5976:+    return N19_OK;
5977:+}
5978:+
5979:+fn n19_append(state:*N19State,record:[]u8)i32 {
5980:+    if(state==null as *N19State || state.*.poisoned!=0){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
5981:+    if(record.len!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5982:+    if(state.*.event_count>=N19_MAX_EVENTS || state.*.journal_bytes>N19_MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES-N19_RECORD_BYTES){return N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY;}
5983:+    let rc:i32=n19_validate(record,state.*.sequence+1);if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}
5984:+    state.*.sequence=state.*.sequence+1;state.*.event_count=state.*.event_count+1;
5985:+    state.*.journal_bytes=state.*.journal_bytes+N19_RECORD_BYTES;state.*.audit_head=state.*.sequence;return N19_OK;

5988:+fn n19_recover(journal:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
5989:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
5990:+    if(journal.len<0 || journal.len>N19_MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
5991:+    if((journal.len % N19_RECORD_BYTES)!=0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
5992:+    let fresh:N19State=n19_empty_state();
5993:+    let at:i32=0;
5994:+    while(at<journal.len){let record:[]u8=journal[at..at+N19_RECORD_BYTES];let rc:i32=n19_append(&fresh,record);
5995:+        if(rc!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc);}at=at+N19_RECORD_BYTES;}
5996:+    fresh.recovered=1;state.*=fresh;return N19_OK;

5999:+// A rejected recovery cannot publish an apparently usable valid prefix.
6000:+// Keep prior counters intact but make the unusable state explicit.
6001:+fn n19_recovery_refuse(state:*N19State,rc:i32)i32 {

6007:+    let at:i64=0;let calls:i32=0;

6010:+        calls=calls+1;if(n==-4){continue;}if(n<=0){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}at=at+n;
6011:+    }
6012:+    if(at!=b.len){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}return at;

6195:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
6196:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
6197:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
6198:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
6199:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6200:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6201:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
6202:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6203:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6204:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6205:+    if(phase==2){

6207:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6208:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;

6211:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6212:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}

6214:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}

6216:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
6217:+}
6218:+
6219:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
6220:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
6221:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
6222:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
6223:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
6224:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
6225:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6226:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
6227:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6228:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6229:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
6230:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
6231:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);

6745:+fn n19_case_failed_recovery_atomicity(state:*N19State)i32 {
6746:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6747:+    state.*=N19State{.sequence=7,.event_count=3,.journal_bytes=96,.audit_head=7,.poisoned=0,.recovered=1};
6748:+    let journal:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);
6749:+    if(journal.len==0 || record.len==0){n19_free(journal);n19_free(record);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6750:+    n19_encode(record,1,"first");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){journal[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
6751:+    n19_encode(record,2,"second");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){journal[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
6752:+    journal[N19_RECORD_BYTES+12]=journal[N19_RECORD_BYTES+12]^1;
6753:+    let rc:i32=n19_recover(journal,state);n19_free(journal);n19_free(record);
6754:+    if(rc!=N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6755:+    if(state.*.sequence!=7 || state.*.event_count!=3 || state.*.journal_bytes!=96 || state.*.audit_head!=7){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6756:+    if(state.*.poisoned!=1 || state.*.recovered!=0){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6757:+    return N19_OK;
6758:+}
6759:+
6760:+fn n19_write_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
6761:+    if(attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6762:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6763:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
6764:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}return rc;
6765:+}
6766:+
6767:+fn n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
6768:+    if(attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6769:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
6770:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){return fd as i32;}
6771:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6772:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,1,"native-io");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return rc0;}
6773:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
6774:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6775:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6776:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
6777:+}
6778:+
6779:+fn n19_read_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
6780:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6781:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rootfd as i32);}
6782:+    let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
6783:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
6784:+}
6785:+
6786:+fn n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
6787:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6788:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
6789:+    let rc:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(fd);
6790:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
6791:+}

6793:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
6794:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6795:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
6796:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6797:+    let rc:i32=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,attempted,committed);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
6798:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
6799:+}
6800:+
6801:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
6802:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6803:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
6804:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
6805:+    let prior:N19State=n19_empty_state();let recovered:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,&prior);
6806:+    if(recovered!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,recovered);}
6807:+    if(prior.sequence!=1 || prior.event_count!=1 || prior.journal_bytes!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || prior.audit_head!=1 || prior.recovered!=1){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
6808:+    let end:i64=n19_seek(fd,0,2);if(end<0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
6809:+    if(end!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
6810:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
6811:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,2,"native-append");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc0);}
6812:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);
6813:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
6814:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
6815:+    let applied:i32=n19_append(&prior,record);n19_free(record);if(applied!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,applied);}
6816:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
6817:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
6818:+}
6819:+
6820:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
6821:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6822:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6823:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
6824:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
6825:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
6826:+}
6827:+
6828:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
6829:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
6830:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
6831:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6832:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6833:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
6834:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
6835:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
6836:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
6837:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
6838:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
6839:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
6840:+}

6850:+fn n19_case_torn(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
6851:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
6852:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_encode(record,1,"torn");let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);n19_free(record);
6853:+    if(written!=16 || n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
6854:+    let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture(root,leaf,&state);if(rc==N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return rc;}if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}return N19_REFUSED_IO;

6856:+
6857:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
6858:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
6859:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
6860:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
6861:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6862:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6863:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
6864:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6865:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6866:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
6867:+    if(phase==2){
6868:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
6869:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6870:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
6871:+    }
6872:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
6873:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6874:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6875:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6876:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6877:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6878:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
6879:+}
6880:+
6881:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
6882:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
6883:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
6884:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
6885:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
6886:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
6887:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
6888:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
6889:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6890:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
6891:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
6892:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
6893:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
6894:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
6895:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
6896:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
6897:+}

6949:+    _zag_print(",0,");n19_print_i64(attempted);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(committed);
6950:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.sequence as i64);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.event_count as i64);
6951:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.audit_head as i64);

6966:+
6967:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
6968:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
6969:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
6970:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
6971:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6972:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6973:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6974:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6975:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
6976:+    return N19_OK;
6977:+}

6979:+fn n19_emit_limit(rc:i32,configured:i64)void {
6980:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,limit,status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
6981:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,");n19_print_i64(configured);
6982:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
6983:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
6984:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");
6985:+}

6987:+fn main()i32 {
6988:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
6989:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
6990:+    // registry state.
6991:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
6992:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
6993:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}

7517:+    let applied:i32=n19_append(&prior,record);n19_free(record);if(applied!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,applied);}
7518:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
7519:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
7520:+}

7522:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
7523:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
7524:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
7525:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
7526:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
7527:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
7528:+}
7529:+
7530:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
7531:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
7532:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
7533:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
7534:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
7535:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
7536:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
7537:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
7538:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
7539:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
7540:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
7541:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
7542:+}
7543:+

7552:+fn n19_case_torn(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
7553:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}

7555:+    if(written!=16 || n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
7556:+    let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture(root,leaf,&state);if(rc==N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return rc;}if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}return N19_REFUSED_IO;

7558:+
7559:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
7560:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
7561:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
7562:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
7563:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
7564:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
7565:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
7566:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7567:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7568:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
7569:+    if(phase==2){
7570:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
7571:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7572:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
7573:+    }
7574:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
7575:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7576:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7577:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7578:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7579:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7580:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
7581:+}
7582:+
7583:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
7584:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
7585:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
7586:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
7587:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
7588:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
7589:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
7590:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
7591:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7592:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
7593:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
7594:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
7595:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
7596:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
7597:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
7598:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
7599:+}

7639:+fn n19_emit(name:[]u8,rc:i32)void {

7641:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
7642:+    // After the fixed envelope marker, emit exactly the 14 schema fields:
7643:+    // case_id, phase, status, detail, attempted, committed, sequence,

7668:+
7669:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
7670:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
7671:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
7672:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
7673:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
7674:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
7675:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
7676:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
7677:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
7678:+    return N19_OK;
7679:+}

7685:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.

7690:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
7691:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment

8331:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
8332:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
8333:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
8334:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
8335:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
8336:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
8337:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
8338:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8339:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8340:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
8341:+    if(phase==2){
8342:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
8343:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8344:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
8345:+    }
8346:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
8347:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8348:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8349:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8350:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8351:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
8352:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
8353:+}
8354:+
8355:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
8356:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
8357:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
8358:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
8359:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {

9046:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
9047:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
9048:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
9049:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
9050:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
9051:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
9052:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
9053:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9054:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9055:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
9056:+    if(phase==2){
9057:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
9058:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9059:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
9060:+    }
9061:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
9062:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9063:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9064:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9065:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9066:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9067:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
9068:+}

9070:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
9071:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
9072:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
9073:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
9074:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
9075:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
9076:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
9077:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
9078:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9079:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9080:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
9081:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
9082:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
9083:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);

9156:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
9157:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
9158:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.

9863:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
9864:+    let prior:N19State=n19_empty_state();let recovered:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,&prior);
9865:+    if(recovered!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,recovered);}
9866:+    if(prior.sequence!=1 || prior.event_count!=1 || prior.journal_bytes!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || prior.audit_head!=1 || prior.recovered!=1){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
9867:+    let end:i64=n19_seek(fd,0,2);if(end<0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
9868:+    if(end!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
9869:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
9870:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,2,"native-append");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc0);}
9871:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);
9872:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
9873:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
9874:+    let applied:i32=n19_append(&prior,record);n19_free(record);if(applied!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,applied);}
9875:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
9876:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;

9879:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
9880:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
9881:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
9882:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
9883:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
9884:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
9885:+}
9886:+
9887:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
9888:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
9889:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
9890:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
9891:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
9892:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
9893:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
9894:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
9895:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
9896:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
9897:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
9898:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

9920:+fn n19_case_torn(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
9921:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}

9927:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
9928:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
9929:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
9930:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
9931:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
9932:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
9933:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
9934:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9935:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9936:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
9937:+    if(phase==2){
9938:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
9939:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9940:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
9941:+    }
9942:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
9943:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9944:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9945:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9946:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9947:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9948:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
9949:+}
9950:+
9951:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
9952:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
9953:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
9954:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
9955:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
9956:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
9957:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
9958:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
9959:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9960:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
9961:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
9962:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
9963:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
9964:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
9965:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
9966:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
9967:+}

10036:+
10037:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
10038:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
10039:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
10040:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
10041:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
10042:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
10043:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
10044:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
10045:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
10046:+    return N19_OK;
10047:+}

10052:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
10053:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
10054:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");

10057:+fn main()i32 {
10058:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
10059:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
10060:+    // registry state.
10061:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
10062:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
10063:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-host-probe")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_case_fault_host_probe(_zag_arg(2));}
10064:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
10065:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-overflow")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_overflow();n19_emit("overflow",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_OVERFLOW);}
10066:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-capacity")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_capacity();n19_emit("capacity",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY);}
10067:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_recovery(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
10068:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-corruption")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_corruption();n19_emit("corruption",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
10069:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery-atomicity")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_failed_recovery_atomicity(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery_atomicity",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
10070:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-limit")==1){let rc:i32=n19_apply_limits(1,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);n19_emit_limit(rc,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
10071:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-error-classification")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_error_classification();n19_emit("error_classification",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
10072:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),1));}
10073:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-half-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),2));}
10074:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-full-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),3));}
10075:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-file-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),4));}
10076:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-root-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),5));}
10077:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-resource-fsize")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_resource_fsize(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
10078:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_open(_zag_arg(2)));}
10079:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-fsync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_fsync(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
10080:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-close")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_close(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
10081:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-retained-sequence")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let attempted:i64=0;let committed:i64=0;let rc:i32=n19_case_retained_sequence(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),&state,&attempted,&committed);n19_emit_state("retained_sequence",rc,&state,attempted,committed);return (rc!=N19_OK) as i32;}
10082:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-host-abi")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}let rc:i32=n19_host_probe(_zag_arg(2));n19_emit("host_abi",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
10083:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-probe-existing")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}let rc:i32=n19_probe_existing(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3));n19_emit("probe_existing",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
10084:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-torn")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}let rc:i32=n19_case_torn(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3));n19_emit("torn",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}

10641:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_encode(record,1,"torn");let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);n19_free(record);
10642:+    if(written!=16 || n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
10643:+    let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture(root,leaf,&state);if(rc==N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return rc;}if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}return N19_REFUSED_IO;
10644:+}
10645:+
10646:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
10647:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
10648:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
10649:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
10650:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
10651:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
10652:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
10653:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10654:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10655:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
10656:+    if(phase==2){
10657:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
10658:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10659:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
10660:+    }
10661:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
10662:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10663:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10664:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10665:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10666:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10667:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
10668:+}
10669:+
10670:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
10671:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
10672:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
10673:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
10674:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
10675:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
10676:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
10677:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
10678:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10679:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
10680:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
10681:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
10682:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
10683:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
10684:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
10685:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
10686:+}

10756:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
10757:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping

10763:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
10764:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
10765:+    return N19_OK;

10882:+// Launches only the N19 candidate as fresh direct child processes, observes
10883:+// wait4 resource accounting, and inspects only owner-created N19 fixture roots.

10899:+fn n19q_run3(binary:[]u8,mode:[]u8,root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)N19QualRun {
10900:+    let result:N19QualRun=n19q_empty_run();
10901:+    let b:[]u8=nio_cstr(binary);let m:[]u8=nio_cstr(mode);let r:[]u8=nio_cstr(root);let l:[]u8=nio_cstr(leaf);
10902:+    let argv:*i64=_zag_malloc(40) as *i64;let env:*i64=_zag_malloc(8) as *i64;
10903:+    let status:*i32=_zag_malloc(8) as *i32;let usage:*i64=_zag_malloc(256) as *i64;

11372:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
11373:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
11374:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
11375:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
11376:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
11377:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
11378:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
11379:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11380:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11381:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
11382:+    if(phase==2){
11383:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
11384:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11385:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
11386:+    }
11387:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
11388:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11389:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11390:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11391:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11392:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
