11396:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
11397:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
11398:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
11399:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
11400:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
11401:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
11402:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
11403:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
11404:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11405:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
11406:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
11407:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
11408:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
11409:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
11410:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
11411:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;

12080:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
12081:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}return rc;
12082:+}
12083:+
12084:+fn n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
12085:+    if(attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12086:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
12087:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){return fd as i32;}
12088:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12089:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,1,"native-io");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return rc0;}
12090:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
12091:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12092:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12093:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
12094:+}
12095:+
12096:+fn n19_read_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
12097:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12098:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rootfd as i32);}
12099:+    let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
12100:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
12101:+}

12103:+fn n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
12104:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12105:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
12106:+    let rc:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(fd);
12107:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
12108:+}

12110:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
12111:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12112:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
12113:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
12114:+    let rc:i32=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,attempted,committed);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
12115:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;

12117:+
12118:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
12119:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12120:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
12121:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
12122:+    let prior:N19State=n19_empty_state();let recovered:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,&prior);
12123:+    if(recovered!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,recovered);}
12124:+    if(prior.sequence!=1 || prior.event_count!=1 || prior.journal_bytes!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || prior.audit_head!=1 || prior.recovered!=1){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
12125:+    let end:i64=n19_seek(fd,0,2);if(end<0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
12126:+    if(end!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
12127:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
12128:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,2,"native-append");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc0);}
12129:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);
12130:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
12131:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
12132:+    let applied:i32=n19_append(&prior,record);n19_free(record);if(applied!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,applied);}
12133:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
12134:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
12135:+}

12137:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
12138:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12139:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
12140:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
12141:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
12142:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
12143:+}
12144:+
12145:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
12146:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
12147:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
12148:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12149:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
12150:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
12151:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
12152:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
12153:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
12154:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
12155:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
12156:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
12157:+}

12161:+}

12178:+fn n19_case_torn(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
12179:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}

12181:+    if(written!=16 || n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
12182:+    let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture(root,leaf,&state);if(rc==N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return rc;}if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}return N19_REFUSED_IO;

12184:+
12185:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
12186:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
12187:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
12188:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
12189:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12190:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
12191:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
12192:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12193:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12194:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
12195:+    if(phase==2){
12196:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
12197:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12198:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
12199:+    }
12200:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
12201:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12202:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12203:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12204:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12205:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12206:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
12207:+}
12208:+
12209:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
12210:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
12211:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
12212:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
12213:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
12214:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
12215:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
12216:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
12217:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12218:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
12219:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
12220:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
12221:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
12222:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
12223:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
12224:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
12225:+}

12265:+fn n19_emit(name:[]u8,rc:i32)void {

12269:+    // case_id, phase, status, detail, attempted, committed, sequence,

12276:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
12277:+    _zag_print(",0,");n19_print_i64(attempted);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(committed);
12278:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.sequence as i64);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.event_count as i64);
12279:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.audit_head as i64);
12280:+    _zag_print(",-1,-1,");
12281:+    if(rc!=N19_OK || state.*.poisoned==1){_zag_print("poisoned");}
12282:+    else if(state.*.recovered==1){_zag_print("recovered");}
12283:+    else{_zag_print("fresh");}
12284:+    _zag_println(",-1,-1");

12294:+
12295:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
12296:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
12297:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
12298:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
12299:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
12300:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
12301:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
12302:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
12303:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
12304:+    return N19_OK;
12305:+}

12307:+fn n19_emit_limit(rc:i32,configured:i64)void {
12308:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,limit,status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
12309:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,");n19_print_i64(configured);
12310:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
12311:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
12312:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");
12313:+}
12314:+
12315:+fn main()i32 {
12316:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
12317:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
12318:+    // registry state.
12319:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
12320:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
12321:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-host-probe")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_case_fault_host_probe(_zag_arg(2));}
12322:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
12323:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-overflow")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_overflow();n19_emit("overflow",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_OVERFLOW);}
12324:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-capacity")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_capacity();n19_emit("capacity",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY);}
12325:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_recovery(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
12326:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-corruption")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_corruption();n19_emit("corruption",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}

14452:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
14453:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.

14495:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {

15235:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){return fd as i32;}
15236:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15237:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,1,"native-io");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return rc0;}
15238:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
15239:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15240:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15241:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
15242:+}
15243:+
15244:+fn n19_read_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
15245:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15246:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rootfd as i32);}
15247:+    let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
15248:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
15249:+}
15250:+
15251:+fn n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State)i32 {
15252:+    if(state==null as *N19State){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15253:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
15254:+    let rc:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,state);let closed:i32=n19_close(fd);
15255:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
15256:+}

15258:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
15259:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15260:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
15261:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
15262:+    let rc:i32=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,attempted,committed);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);
15263:+    if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
15264:+}
15265:+
15266:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
15267:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15268:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
15269:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
15270:+    let prior:N19State=n19_empty_state();let recovered:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,&prior);
15271:+    if(recovered!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,recovered);}
15272:+    if(prior.sequence!=1 || prior.event_count!=1 || prior.journal_bytes!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || prior.audit_head!=1 || prior.recovered!=1){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
15273:+    let end:i64=n19_seek(fd,0,2);if(end<0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
15274:+    if(end!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
15275:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
15276:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,2,"native-append");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc0);}
15277:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);
15278:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
15279:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
15280:+    let applied:i32=n19_append(&prior,record);n19_free(record);if(applied!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,applied);}
15281:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
15282:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
15283:+}

15285:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
15286:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15287:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
15288:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
15289:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
15290:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
15291:+}
15292:+
15293:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
15294:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
15295:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
15296:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15297:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
15298:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
15299:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
15300:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
15301:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
15302:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
15303:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
15304:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
15305:+}

15326:+fn n19_case_torn(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
15327:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}

15332:+
15333:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
15334:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
15335:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
15336:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
15337:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15338:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
15339:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
15340:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15341:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15342:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
15343:+    if(phase==2){
15344:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
15345:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15346:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
15347:+    }
15348:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
15349:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15350:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15351:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15352:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15353:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15354:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
15355:+}
15356:+
15357:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
15358:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
15359:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
15360:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
15361:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
15362:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
15363:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
15364:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
15365:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15366:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
15367:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
15368:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
15369:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
15370:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
15371:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
15372:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
15373:+}

15442:+
15443:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
15444:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
15445:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
15446:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
15447:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
15448:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
15449:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
15450:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
15451:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
15452:+    return N19_OK;
15453:+}

15457:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,");n19_print_i64(configured);
15458:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
15459:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
15460:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");

15463:+fn main()i32 {
15464:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
15465:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
15466:+    // registry state.
15467:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
15468:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
15469:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-host-probe")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_case_fault_host_probe(_zag_arg(2));}
15470:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
15471:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-overflow")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_overflow();n19_emit("overflow",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_OVERFLOW);}
15472:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-capacity")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_capacity();n19_emit("capacity",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY);}
15473:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_recovery(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
15474:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-corruption")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_corruption();n19_emit("corruption",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
15475:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery-atomicity")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_failed_recovery_atomicity(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery_atomicity",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
15476:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-limit")==1){let rc:i32=n19_apply_limits(1,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);n19_emit_limit(rc,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
15477:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-error-classification")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_error_classification();n19_emit("error_classification",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}

15680:+// R33-N19 native qualification supervisor V1.
15681:+// Launches only the N19 candidate as fresh direct child processes, observes

15683:+// No learner, parent state, registry, training, evaluator, or foreign runtime.
15684:+@import("n19_native_io_v1.zag")
15685:+
15686:+struct N19QualRun {
15687:+    started:i32,
15688:+    exit_code:i32,
15689:+    signal:i32,
15690:+    cpu_us:i64,
15691:+    peak_rss:i64,
15692:+}

15694:+fn n19q_empty_run()N19QualRun {
15695:+    return N19QualRun{.started=0,.exit_code=-1,.signal=0,.cpu_us=0,.peak_rss=0};
15696:+}
15697:+
15698:+fn n19q_run3(binary:[]u8,mode:[]u8,root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)N19QualRun {
15699:+    let result:N19QualRun=n19q_empty_run();
15700:+    let b:[]u8=nio_cstr(binary);let m:[]u8=nio_cstr(mode);let r:[]u8=nio_cstr(root);let l:[]u8=nio_cstr(leaf);
15701:+    let argv:*i64=_zag_malloc(40) as *i64;let env:*i64=_zag_malloc(8) as *i64;
15702:+    let status:*i32=_zag_malloc(8) as *i32;let usage:*i64=_zag_malloc(256) as *i64;
15703:+    if(b.len==0 || m.len==0 || r.len==0 || l.len==0 || argv==null as *i64 || env==null as *i64 || status==null as *i32 || usage==null as *i64){
15704:+        nio_free(b);nio_free(m);nio_free(r);nio_free(l);
15705:+        if(argv!=null as *i64){_zag_free(argv as *i8);}if(env!=null as *i64){_zag_free(env as *i8);}
15706:+        if(status!=null as *i32){_zag_free(status as *i8);}if(usage!=null as *i64){_zag_free(usage as *i8);}return result;
15707:+    }

16171:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
16172:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
16173:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
16174:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
16175:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
16176:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
16177:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
16178:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16179:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16180:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
16181:+    if(phase==2){
16182:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
16183:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16184:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
16185:+    }
16186:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
16187:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16188:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16189:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16190:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16191:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16192:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
16193:+}
16194:+
16195:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
16196:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
16197:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
16198:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
16199:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
16200:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
16201:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
16202:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
16203:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16204:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
16205:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
16206:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
16207:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
16208:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
16209:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
16210:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
16211:+}

16244:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}

16246:+    let raw:i64=_zag_darwin_syscall(6,fd,0,0,0,0,0);let classified:i32=n19h_io_status(raw);n19_close(rootfd);
16247:+    n19_emit_fault("close",raw,classified);
16248:+    if(raw<0 && classified==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;
16249:+}
16250:+
16251:+fn n19_emit(name:[]u8,rc:i32)void {
16252:+    // -1 is explicit missingness for values not observed by this case.
16253:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
16254:+    // After the fixed envelope marker, emit exactly the 14 schema fields:
16255:+    // case_id, phase, status, detail, attempted, committed, sequence,
16256:+    // event_count, audit_head, resource_limit, resource_observed,
16257:+    // recovery_state, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes.
16258:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,missing,-1,-1");_zag_println("");
16259:+}
16260:+
16261:+fn n19_emit_state(name:[]u8,rc:i32,state:*N19State,attempted:i64,committed:i64)void {
16262:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
16263:+    _zag_print(",0,");n19_print_i64(attempted);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(committed);
16264:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.sequence as i64);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.event_count as i64);
16265:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.audit_head as i64);
16266:+    _zag_print(",-1,-1,");
16267:+    if(rc!=N19_OK || state.*.poisoned==1){_zag_print("poisoned");}
16268:+    else if(state.*.recovered==1){_zag_print("recovered");}
16269:+    else{_zag_print("fresh");}
16270:+    _zag_println(",-1,-1");
16271:+}
16272:+
16273:+fn n19_exit_ok(rc:i32)i32 {
16274:+    if(rc==N19_OK){return 0;}return 1;
16275:+}
16276:+
16277:+fn n19_exit_expected(rc:i32,want:i32)i32 {
16278:+    if(rc==want){return 0;}return 1;
16279:+}
16280:+
16281:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
16282:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
16283:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
16284:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
16285:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
16286:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
16287:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
16288:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
16289:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
16290:+    return N19_OK;
16291:+}
16292:+
16293:+fn n19_emit_limit(rc:i32,configured:i64)void {
16294:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,limit,status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
16295:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,");n19_print_i64(configured);
16296:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
16297:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
16298:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");
16299:+}

17098:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
17099:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
17100:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
17101:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
17102:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
17103:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}

17121:+
17122:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
17123:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
17124:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
17125:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
17126:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
17127:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
17128:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
17129:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
17130:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17131:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17132:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
17133:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
17134:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
17135:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
17136:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
17137:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;

17888:+}
17889:+
17890:+fn n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd:i64,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
17891:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
17892:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;
17893:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,fd as i32);}
17894:+    let prior:N19State=n19_empty_state();let recovered:i32=n19_recover_fd(fd,&prior);
17895:+    if(recovered!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,recovered);}
17896:+    if(prior.sequence!=1 || prior.event_count!=1 || prior.journal_bytes!=N19_RECORD_BYTES || prior.audit_head!=1 || prior.recovered!=1){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
17897:+    let end:i64=n19_seek(fd,0,2);if(end<0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
17898:+    if(end!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
17899:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
17900:+    let rc0:i32=n19_encode(record,2,"native-append");if(rc0!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,rc0);}
17901:+    attempted.*=N19_RECORD_BYTES;let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);
17902:+    if(written!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
17903:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
17904:+    let applied:i32=n19_append(&prior,record);n19_free(record);if(applied!=N19_OK){n19_close(fd);return n19_recovery_refuse(state,applied);}
17905:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}
17906:+    prior.recovered=1;state.*=prior;committed.*=written;return N19_OK;
17907:+}
17908:+
17909:+fn n19_case_io(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
17910:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
17911:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
17912:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
17913:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
17914:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
17915:+}
17916:+
17917:+// One retained root for the entire write -> append -> recovery sequence.
17918:+// Fresh-process root identity is a separate admission concern, not this claim.
17919:+fn n19_case_retained_sequence(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,state:*N19State,attempted:*i64,committed:*i64)i32 {
17920:+    if(state==null as *N19State || attempted==null as *i64 || committed==null as *i64){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
17921:+    attempted.*=0;committed.*=0;let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
17922:+    let rc:i32=n19_write_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,attempted,committed);
17923:+    if(rc==N19_OK){let next_attempted:i64=0;let next_committed:i64=0;
17924:+        rc=n19_append_existing_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state,&next_attempted,&next_committed);
17925:+        attempted.*=attempted.*+next_attempted;committed.*=committed.*+next_committed;}
17926:+    if(rc==N19_OK){rc=n19_read_fixture_at(rootfd,leaf,state);}
17927:+    if(rc==N19_OK && (state.*.sequence!=2 || state.*.event_count!=2 || state.*.journal_bytes!=64 || state.*.audit_head!=2 || state.*.recovered!=1 || state.*.poisoned!=0)){rc=n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
17928:+    let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(closed!=N19_OK){return n19_recovery_refuse(state,N19_REFUSED_IO);}return rc;
17929:+}
17930:+
17931:+fn n19_probe_existing(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
17932:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,0);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}let c1:i32=n19_close(fd);let c2:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(c1!=N19_OK || c2!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}return N19_OK;
17933:+}
17934:+
17935:+fn n19_host_probe(root:[]u8)i32 {
17936:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}return n19_host_probe_fd(rootfd);
17937:+}
17938:+
17939:+fn n19_host_probe_fd(rootfd:i64)i32 {
17940:+    let synced:i64=n19_sync(rootfd);let closed:i32=n19_close(rootfd);if(synced!=0 || closed!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}return N19_OK;
17941:+}
17942:+
17943:+fn n19_case_fault_host_probe(root:[]u8)i32 {
17944:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(fd<0){return fd as i32;}
17945:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17946:+    let rc:i32=n19_host_probe_fd(fd);n19_emit("host_probe_closed_root",rc);
17947:+    return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_IO);
17948:+}

17950:+fn n19_case_torn(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
17951:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
17952:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_encode(record,1,"torn");let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);n19_free(record);
17953:+    if(written!=16 || n19_sync(fd)!=0 || n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
17954:+    let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_read_fixture(root,leaf,&state);if(rc==N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY){return rc;}if(rc!=N19_OK){return rc;}return N19_REFUSED_IO;
17955:+}
17956:+
17957:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
17958:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
17959:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
17960:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
17961:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
17962:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
17963:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
17964:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17965:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17966:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
17967:+    if(phase==2){
17968:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
17969:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17970:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
17971:+    }
17972:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
17973:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17974:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17975:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17976:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17977:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17978:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
17979:+}
17980:+
17981:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
17982:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
17983:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
17984:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
17985:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
17986:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
17987:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
17988:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
17989:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17990:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
17991:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
17992:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
17993:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
17994:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
17995:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
17996:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
17997:+}

18014:+    let h:N19HostResult=n19h_leaf_open(rootfd,"definitely-missing-n19-v3",0);n19_close(rootfd);
18015:+    n19_emit_fault("open",h.detail,h.status);
18016:+    if(h.fd<0 && h.status==N19_REFUSED_PATH && h.detail<0){return N19_OK;}return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;

18019:+fn n19_case_fault_fsync(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
18020:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
18021:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
18022:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18023:+    let raw:i64=n19_sync(fd);let classified:i32=n19h_io_status(raw);n19_close(rootfd);
18024:+    n19_emit_fault("fsync",raw,classified);

18030:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
18031:+    if(n19_close(fd)!=N19_OK){n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18032:+    let raw:i64=_zag_darwin_syscall(6,fd,0,0,0,0,0);let classified:i32=n19h_io_status(raw);n19_close(rootfd);
18033:+    n19_emit_fault("close",raw,classified);

18037:+fn n19_emit(name:[]u8,rc:i32)void {
18038:+    // -1 is explicit missingness for values not observed by this case.
18039:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
18040:+    // After the fixed envelope marker, emit exactly the 14 schema fields:
18041:+    // case_id, phase, status, detail, attempted, committed, sequence,
18042:+    // event_count, audit_head, resource_limit, resource_observed,
18043:+    // recovery_state, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes.
18044:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,missing,-1,-1");_zag_println("");
18045:+}
18046:+
18047:+fn n19_emit_state(name:[]u8,rc:i32,state:*N19State,attempted:i64,committed:i64)void {
18048:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
18049:+    _zag_print(",0,");n19_print_i64(attempted);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(committed);
18050:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.sequence as i64);_zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.event_count as i64);
18051:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.audit_head as i64);
18052:+    _zag_print(",-1,-1,");
18053:+    if(rc!=N19_OK || state.*.poisoned==1){_zag_print("poisoned");}
18054:+    else if(state.*.recovered==1){_zag_print("recovered");}
18055:+    else{_zag_print("fresh");}
18056:+    _zag_println(",-1,-1");
18057:+}

18059:+fn n19_exit_ok(rc:i32)i32 {
18060:+    if(rc==N19_OK){return 0;}return 1;
18061:+}
18062:+
18063:+fn n19_exit_expected(rc:i32,want:i32)i32 {
18064:+    if(rc==want){return 0;}return 1;
18065:+}
18066:+
18067:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
18068:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
18069:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
18070:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
18071:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18072:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18073:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18074:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18075:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18076:+    return N19_OK;
18077:+}
18078:+
18079:+fn n19_emit_limit(rc:i32,configured:i64)void {
18080:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,limit,status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);
18081:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,");n19_print_i64(configured);
18082:+    // No runtime usage meter is available in this bounded fixture. Missing
18083:+    // observation stays -1 and is never replaced by the configured ceiling.
18084:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");
18085:+}

18087:+fn main()i32 {
18088:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
18089:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
18090:+    // registry state.
18091:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
18092:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
18093:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-host-probe")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_case_fault_host_probe(_zag_arg(2));}
18094:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
18095:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-overflow")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_overflow();n19_emit("overflow",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_OVERFLOW);}
18096:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-capacity")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_capacity();n19_emit("capacity",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY);}
18097:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_recovery(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
18098:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-corruption")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_corruption();n19_emit("corruption",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
18099:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery-atomicity")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_failed_recovery_atomicity(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery_atomicity",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
18100:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-limit")==1){let rc:i32=n19_apply_limits(1,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);n19_emit_limit(rc,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
18101:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-error-classification")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_error_classification();n19_emit("error_classification",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
18102:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),1));}
18103:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-half-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),2));}
18104:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-full-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),3));}
18105:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-file-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),4));}
18106:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-root-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),5));}
18107:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-resource-fsize")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_resource_fsize(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
18108:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_open(_zag_arg(2)));}
18109:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-fsync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_fsync(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
18110:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-close")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_close(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
18111:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-retained-sequence")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let attempted:i64=0;let committed:i64=0;let rc:i32=n19_case_retained_sequence(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),&state,&attempted,&committed);n19_emit_state("retained_sequence",rc,&state,attempted,committed);return (rc!=N19_OK) as i32;}
18112:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-host-abi")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}let rc:i32=n19_host_probe(_zag_arg(2));n19_emit("host_abi",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}

18330:+    started:i32,
18331:+    exit_code:i32,
18332:+    signal:i32,

18337:+fn n19q_empty_run()N19QualRun {
18338:+    return N19QualRun{.started=0,.exit_code=-1,.signal=0,.cpu_us=0,.peak_rss=0};
18339:+}

18341:+fn n19q_run3(binary:[]u8,mode:[]u8,root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)N19QualRun {
18342:+    let result:N19QualRun=n19q_empty_run();
18343:+    let b:[]u8=nio_cstr(binary);let m:[]u8=nio_cstr(mode);let r:[]u8=nio_cstr(root);let l:[]u8=nio_cstr(leaf);
18344:+    let argv:*i64=_zag_malloc(40) as *i64;let env:*i64=_zag_malloc(8) as *i64;
18345:+    let status:*i32=_zag_malloc(8) as *i32;let usage:*i64=_zag_malloc(256) as *i64;
18346:+    if(b.len==0 || m.len==0 || r.len==0 || l.len==0 || argv==null as *i64 || env==null as *i64 || status==null as *i32 || usage==null as *i64){
18347:+        nio_free(b);nio_free(m);nio_free(r);nio_free(l);
18348:+        if(argv!=null as *i64){_zag_free(argv as *i8);}if(env!=null as *i64){_zag_free(env as *i8);}
18349:+        if(status!=null as *i32){_zag_free(status as *i8);}if(usage!=null as *i64){_zag_free(usage as *i8);}return result;
18350:+    }
18351:+    argv[0]=_zag_slice_ptr(b) as i64;argv[1]=_zag_slice_ptr(m) as i64;argv[2]=_zag_slice_ptr(r) as i64;argv[3]=_zag_slice_ptr(l) as i64;argv[4]=0;env[0]=0;
18352:+    status[0]=0;let i:i32=0;while(i<32){usage[i]=0;i=i+1;}
18353:+    let pid:i64=_zag_darwin_fork();
18354:+    if(pid==0){_zag_darwin_syscall(59,_zag_slice_ptr(b) as i64,argv as i64,env as i64,0,0,0);_zag_exit(127);}

18814:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
18815:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
18816:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
18817:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
18818:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
18819:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
18820:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
18821:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18822:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18823:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
18824:+    if(phase==2){
18825:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
18826:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18827:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
18828:+    }
18829:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
18830:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18831:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18832:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18833:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18834:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18835:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
18836:+}
18837:+
18838:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
18839:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
18840:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
18841:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
18842:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
18843:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
18844:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
18845:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
18846:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18847:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
18848:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
18849:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
18850:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
18851:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
18852:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
18853:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
18854:+}

18895:+    // -1 is explicit missingness for values not observed by this case.
18896:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);

18898:+    // case_id, phase, status, detail, attempted, committed, sequence,
18899:+    // event_count, audit_head, resource_limit, resource_observed,
18900:+    // recovery_state, stdout_bytes, stderr_bytes.
18901:+    _zag_print(",0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,missing,-1,-1");_zag_println("");
18902:+}

18905:+    _zag_print("N19_TELEMETRY,");_zag_print(name);_zag_print(",status,");n19_print_i64(rc as i64);

18908:+    _zag_print(",");n19_print_i64(state.*.audit_head as i64);

18911:+    else if(state.*.recovered==1){_zag_print("recovered");}

18924:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
18925:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
18926:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
18927:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
18928:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18929:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18930:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18931:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18932:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
18933:+    return N19_OK;
18934:+}

18941:+    _zag_println(",-1,missing,-1,-1");

19672:+// Deliberately terminate the process at one of five write phases. These modes
19673:+// are used only by the native qualification supervisor, which then launches a
19674:+// separate process for recovery. They model process death, not power loss.
19675:+fn n19_crash_phase(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8,phase:i32)i32 {
19676:+    if(phase<1 || phase>5){return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
19677:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
19678:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
19679:+    if(phase==1){_zag_exit(80);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19680:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19681:+    if(n19_encode(record,1,"crash-phase")!=N19_OK){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED;}
19682:+    if(phase==2){
19683:+        let half:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record[0..16]);
19684:+        if(half!=16){n19_free(record);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19685:+        _zag_exit(81);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
19686:+    }
19687:+    let full:i64=n19_write_all(fd,record);n19_free(record);
19688:+    if(full!=N19_RECORD_BYTES){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19689:+    if(phase==3){_zag_exit(82);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19690:+    if(n19_sync(fd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19691:+    if(phase==4){_zag_exit(83);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19692:+    if(n19_sync(rootfd)!=0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19693:+    _zag_exit(84);return N19_REFUSED_IO;
19694:+}
19695:+
19696:+// Install a hard 32-byte RLIMIT_FSIZE and try to write two records. Normally
19697:+// Darwin terminates the child with SIGXFSZ on the second write. If the syscall
19698:+// instead returns an error, that is also a valid refusal path; the supervisor
19699:+// independently verifies that the file never grows beyond the limit.
19700:+fn n19_case_resource_fsize(root:[]u8,leaf:[]u8)i32 {
19701:+    let limited:i32=n19_apply_limits(5,N19_RECORD_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);if(limited!=N19_OK){return limited;}
19702:+    let rootfd:i64=n19_open_root(root);if(rootfd<0){return rootfd as i32;}
19703:+    let fd:i64=n19_open_regular_at(rootfd,leaf,1);if(fd<0){n19_close(rootfd);return fd as i32;}
19704:+    let bytes:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES*2);if(bytes.len==0){n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19705:+    let record:[]u8=n19_alloc(N19_RECORD_BYTES);if(record.len==0){n19_free(bytes);n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);return N19_REFUSED_IO;}
19706:+    n19_encode(record,1,"limit-one");let i:i32=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
19707:+    n19_encode(record,2,"limit-two");i=0;while(i<N19_RECORD_BYTES){bytes[N19_RECORD_BYTES+i]=record[i];i=i+1;}
19708:+    n19_free(record);let written:i64=n19_write_all(fd,bytes);n19_free(bytes);
19709:+    n19_close(fd);n19_close(rootfd);
19710:+    if(written==N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_OK;}
19711:+    return N19_REFUSED_RESOURCE;
19712:+}

19781:+
19782:+// Classification-only gate over adapter-owned errno mappings. Runtime fault
19783:+// fixtures below separately exercise real descriptors. This keeps the mapping
19784:+// contract falsifiable without pretending a synthetic errno is an OS event.
19785:+fn n19_case_error_classification()i32 {
19786:+    if(n19h_open_status(-2)!=N19_REFUSED_PATH){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
19787:+    if(n19h_open_status(-22)!=N19_REFUSED_HOST_ABI){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
19788:+    if(n19h_open_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
19789:+    if(n19h_io_status(-5)!=N19_REFUSED_IO){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
19790:+    if(n19h_io_status(0)!=N19_OK){return N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY;}
19791:+    return N19_OK;
19792:+}

19802:+fn main()i32 {
19803:+    // Every filesystem mode accepts an owner-created capability root plus one
19804:+    // relative leaf. No mode reads or writes canonical R27 or experiment
19805:+    // registry state.
19806:+    if(_zag_argc()<2 || _zag_argc()>4){return 2;}
19807:+    let mode:[]u8=_zag_arg(1);
19808:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-host-probe")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_case_fault_host_probe(_zag_arg(2));}
19809:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-malformed")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_malformed();n19_emit("malformed",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_MALFORMED);}
19810:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-overflow")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_overflow();n19_emit("overflow",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_OVERFLOW);}
19811:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-capacity")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_capacity();n19_emit("capacity",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_CAPACITY);}

19813:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-corruption")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_corruption();n19_emit("corruption",rc);return n19_exit_expected(rc,N19_REFUSED_RECOVERY);}
19814:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-recovery-atomicity")==1){let state:N19State=n19_empty_state();let rc:i32=n19_case_failed_recovery_atomicity(&state);n19_emit_state("recovery_atomicity",rc,&state,-1,-1);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
19815:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-limit")==1){let rc:i32=n19_apply_limits(1,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,N19_MAX_EVENTS);n19_emit_limit(rc,N19_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
19816:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-error-classification")==1){let rc:i32=n19_case_error_classification();n19_emit("error_classification",rc);return n19_exit_ok(rc);}
19817:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),1));}
19818:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-half-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),2));}
19819:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-full-write")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),3));}
19820:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-file-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),4));}
19821:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-crash-after-root-sync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_crash_phase(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3),5));}
19822:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-resource-fsize")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_resource_fsize(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
19823:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-open")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=3){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_open(_zag_arg(2)));}
19824:+    if(_zag_strcmp(mode,"case-fault-fsync")==1){if(_zag_argc()!=4){return 2;}return n19_exit_ok(n19_case_fault_fsync(_zag_arg(2),_zag_arg(3)));}
